description: Render a WHOLE ARRANGEMENT in one call — a film cue, a string quartet, a big-band chart: every part played by its doseedo instrument model, one stem per part, all from bar 1 at your tempo, plus a summed mix. Input ONE of: parts[] ({name, instrument, timbre_preset?, lora_id?, notes[]} — the calls doseedo_instruments lists), midi_url (a multi-track SMF: one part per track), or musicxml_url (MusicXML/.mxl from any notation app — dynamics, hairpins, staccato/accents, pizz./arco and con sord. are performed; transposing parts are read at concert pitch). Each part is matched to a catalog instrument by its written name, then its General MIDI program; name any part yourself with instruments {"<part name or index>": {instrument, timbre_preset?}}. A chord on a one-line instrument is split into voices (one stem each). Limits: ≤ 8 stems per call (split a big score into sections — every call starts at bar 1, so the stems line up), ONE World/custom (adapter-backed) instrument per call, no synth / electronic one-shot parts (doseedo_render_midi), ≤ 600 s. Timing: bpm and/or tempo_map ([{beat, bpm}] — doseedo_tempo_map builds one that lands film hits on downbeats); a MIDI/MusicXML file's own tempo is used unless you pass one. Every part is played as doseedo_render_midi plays it (autocorrect anchoring, staccato floor, tape-speed high violin). Result: parts[{name, instrument, url, fit, timbre, level, hard_span, tape_spans}] — fit.verdict / fit.coverage say whether each part PLAYED its notes (a failed part is re-rolled once automatically) — plus mix_url. Then doseedo_session_from_stems {from_job} builds the Logic/Ableton project (each part's audio + its MIDI + the tempo map). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (~1–4 min). Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

bpm.description: Tempo of the parts (10–400). Required with parts[] unless tempo_map is given; overrides a file's own tempo.

duration_seconds.description: Render length (default: the last note + 2 s; ≤ 600).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

instruments.description: Name the instrument for any part: {"Violin I": {"instrument": "violin"}, "2": {"instrument": "acoustic_guitar", "timbre_preset": "koto:preset1"}} — key = the part name or its 0-based index. Wins over the name/program match.

midi_url.description: Alternative to parts: a multi-track Standard MIDI File (≤ 2 MiB) — a doseedo result link or a public https URL. Channel 10 = drums.

mix.description: Also bounce a summed mix of the stems (default true).

musicxml_url.description: Alternative to parts: a MusicXML score (.musicxml / .xml / .mxl, ≤ 8 MiB) exported from Dorico, Sibelius, Finale, MuseScore, or written by you.

parts.description: The parts you wrote: [{name?, instrument, timbre_preset?, lora_id?, notes:[{pitch, start_beats, duration_beats, velocity?}]}] — beats from bar 1, concert pitch. instrument/timbre_preset = a doseedo_instruments call.

score_url.description: Alternative to parts: a score file URL — MIDI or MusicXML, told apart by its content.

seed.description: Random seed (reuse to re-render close to the same performance).

tempo_map.description: Tempo changes [{beat, bpm}] (first point at beat 0). Overrides a file's own tempo.

name: doseedo_render_score
title: Render a whole score
